title: Wire audited Solana facts into the final CA analysis result
objective: Make the final Solana CA result consume pinned Pump creator evidence, the complete-only holder snapshot and complete-from-creation Dev history services, and expose structured evidence, completeness and warnings without making a live provider call.
forbidden_actions: Do not call RPC, Helius, Dune or any external provider; tests must use pinned fixtures only.
Do not modify the Pump decoder, holder snapshot service, Dev history service, their fixtures or their rule semantics.
Do not infer a creator from payer, signer, metadata or a third-party label when pinned Pump create evidence is absent.
Do not return holder concentration for a partial snapshot or Dev totals for incomplete-from-creation history.
Do not treat a token transfer as a sale, merge related-wallet activity into direct Dev activity, or use wallet quality as a holder-exclusion rule.
Do not activate BSC, Robinhood or a live data source.
